.qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r4/rules/harbor-webdev-rubric-qc/references/quality-checks.md section '16 · environment_does_not_leak_the_answer' (and #15 defect: COPY of solution/ or tests/)
evidence: Agent image: task/environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template Dockerfile (diff empty). Its only content-bearing steps are line 14 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/' and line 15 'COPY assets/ /assets/'; lines 17-23 'mkdir -p /app && git -C /app init ... && touch /app/.gitkeep && git -C /app add .gitkeep && git -C /app commit -m "Initialize task workspace"' leave /app holding only .gitkeep. No COPY of solution/ or tests/; the build context environment/ contains only Dockerfile, assets/seed_data.json and the three instructions/*.md files (no .dockerignore, no hidden files, no starter/skeleton/schema/route list/partial UI). task.toml: environment_mode = "separate" (line 28), no [environment].docker_image, so the verifier's tests/ and the solution are not in the agent world. Assets: environment/assets/seed_data.json (sha256 f69616e2...be36, equal to solution/app/seed/seed_data.json and to the raw-evidence-index entry) holds only raw inputs - clock, firm, 5 accounts, timer_options_days [null,1,7,30], 3 matters with id/title/client/timer_days/walled, 17 messages with id/author/at/body/hold and optional parent/versions, and read_up_to positions. It carries no derived/expected state (no precomputed purge results, unread counts, deleted flags, transcript output, rendered HTML, or SQL schema); e.g. K-1 (2026-05-01, 7-day matter) and K-10 (exactly 7 days before the clock) are present and the app must compute their removal itself. Notes: the three /instructions files are requester-voice product notes (walls, retention, threads, formatting, runtime contract), not a solution. Grep of instruction.md and all notes for judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score.py|playwright|claude|glm|/tests|sentinel|probe|golden|oracle returned no hits. Longest verbatim overlap (normalised whitespace, SequenceMatcher) between any brief/note file and any tests/**/judge.toml|prompt.md|app_context.md is 48 chars, and that is the shared account table header/row also given to the judge in app_context; the longest overlap with criterion text is 44 chars (' shows a short preview of the linked message', conversations.md vs functional/judge.toml) - an ordinary requirement phrase, not reproduction of a criterion. Adversarial attempts: (a) broken app passing because of a leak - no finished app, server code, schema, endpoint list or criterion text is reachable from the agent image, so an agent cannot copy a deliverable or tune to the judge's steps from the environment; (b) conforming alternative failing because of the environment - the environment imposes no starter structure that a different valid design would conflict with, /app is empty. Evidence is static source inspection of the frozen bytes; I did not docker-build and list the agent image (not required to establish this row given the Dockerfile and build context are fully enumerated).
